accepted_domain_recovery: Reproduce known control effects without an Emergentist variable.
held_out_incremental_prediction: Content-specific change in present action beyond matched controls.
independent_replication: Independent sample and analysts reproduce the effect.
kill_criterion: Effect vanishes under fair controls or does not replicate.
native_equations: Native behavioral or cognitive model selected before data contact.
native_objects: Present representations, salience, demand, reward, memory, expectancy and action.
no_placement_rival: Generic framing, salience, demand, memory or reward model.
permutation_challenge: Permute content while matching salience, demand and reward.
question: Does changing represented future content alter present selection beyond salience, demand, reward framing, memory, and expectancy?
survivor: Present models can guide ordinary present action.
title: Controlled future-content effect
